reasons.executorGrowth: border texel ring around the image; also GL_CLAMP + linear without GPS_CAP_BORDER_LINEAR. With it, coordinates outside [0, 1] are drawn: GL clamps first (half edge, half border at any distance), D3D's border is all border, so the shader saturates each such axis before texld on the border sampler (key bits 16-19, $glg_clamp_mask).
